evidenceBasis: Direct harness stdout/checkpoints, native screenshots, generated localStorage envelope, and final UI download. This consolidates multiple disposable harness contexts that continued the same naturally earned save after harness selector issues.

steps.result: Native PLAY -> hero creation; named character R1 Natural.
Native villageElder dialogue textline clicks, in order.

textlines.displayedText: Great... Thank you for help, but I think I should go there then. Maybe it will help me remember more.
I would like an axe, for solid damage from every strike

steps.result: Equipped the actual Cheap iron axe from the elder. Entered Infested field through normal travel. Native location had 15 groups; defeated the 15 required groups across trips, with normal retreat and Village rest between. Returned to Village after the first clear.

Clicked native elder line `cleared field`, displayed `I cleared the field, just as you asked me to`. The line had to be replayed after restoring a naturally generated checkpoint because the earlier checkpoint preceded its manual save.
Native oldCraftsman dialogue; clicked `hello` (displayed `Hello, I heard you wanted to talk to me?`) and `learn` (displayed `Sure, I'm in no hurry.`). Equipped the actual Old axe.

Started Village action `Gather wood on the outskirts` with Old axe equipped. Advanced actual registered game timers using Playwright page.clock.runFor(10000) in 360 bounded increments. No set_speed hook was available; fastForward and any state/resource grants were not used. Native saved activity and inventory both recorded 95 Rough wood logs.

Restored the generated save in a fresh disposable context, verified the UI showed Rough wood log x95, stopped woodcutting through its native `Stop woodcutting` control, manually saved and used the native Export button. Final UI showed Village, no work running, and Cheap iron axe plus Old axe equipped.

harnessNote: An early counter inspected only the first inventory control and fell back to one. The saved native activity and inventory each held 95 logs; the finalizer enumerated displayed controls and verified the exported envelope count.
